Cases
* Please cover the missing digits:

  • Tests: 0 and 9

  • Validators: 0, 5 and 6

Thanks.
can you explain the problem in detail for better understanding

This is a problem created specifically for the Reverse mode of Clash of Code.
There is no statement in Reverse mode. Instead, players will be presented with only the Test Cases, and the objective is to inspect the input and output of the cases and guess the logic behind them.
I make Test 5 to make the process of guessing quicker.
If you find that it may be hard for players to guess, please point it out so I can edit/add more tests with more hints.

I got you.
- Blackboard in Test 4 has now 13 + 19, covering 9.
- One of the classmates is now a zero in Val/Test 1.
- Blackboard in Val 2 has now 8 + 5, covering 5.
- The classmate in Val 3 thinks the result is 4, covering 4.
- Blackboard in Val 5 has now 321 = 6, covering 6, and also a heart S2 to make the output different from the Test.
It seems that the digit 4 is now missing in the tests…
